patch:
diff --git a/settings.py b/settings.py
index 5a9e84d..9897329 100644
--- a/settings.py
+++ b/settings.py
@@ -3,4 +3,4 @@
 
 def timeout_seconds(config: dict[str, object]) -> int:
     """Return the configured timeout or the 30 second default."""
-    return int(config.get("timeot_seconds", 30))
+    return int(config.get("timeout_seconds", 30))
final_text: Fixed a typo in `settings.py`: the config key was `"timeot_seconds"`, so a configured `timeout_seconds` value was ignored and the default always applied. Corrected it to `"timeout_seconds"` while keeping the documented `30`-second default. All tests pass (`2 passed`).
